description:
Session 4 (receipt: dev/benchmarks/tuning_profiles/2026-08-22-post-cutover-receipt-4.md) establishes the first attributable verdict of the pinned selector non-regression procedure, and it is FAIL at exactly one cell: bit_backend/not_inplace/words=1 (scalar) at ratio 1.100028 against tau_cell = 1.05 — +0.243682 ns/call over the reference arm's 2.436132 — with every attribution precondition passing (precision margin 5.604, half-split null 1.001808; the cell's natural sigma is 0.000222 so its coverage floor is trivially cleared). The other thirty-three cells pass, the set geomean is 1.002950, and the two popcount cells that tripped all three prior sessions read 0.996574 and 1.002381 after the DEC-G bake (676f55a2).

Diagnose and remove the regression, or establish with owner sign-off that it is not the reconciliation's cost to remove. Context the receipt records: the cell's layout sensitivity is the largest in the pinned set (s_R = 0.093325, s_C = 0.103409, natural sigma 0.000222 — one natural rebuild barely moves it, layout moves it +/-10 %); every single-build comparison in the record reads this cell near 0.85 against the committed baseline (0.851509, 0.853275, 0.851143, 0.849929 across four independent candidate builds), so single-build comparisons cannot see this excursion in either direction. The compiled candidate source is ec857d2f, whose diff from receipt-3's candidate (46d21d6d) in crates/ is exactly the 676f55a2 DEC-G bake chain.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The cause of the +10 % pooled-ensemble excursion at bit_backend/not_inplace/words=1 is identified and stated with evidence tying it to a specific code or codegen property of the candidate revision (not to a layout draw — the ensemble already averages 256 draws per arm).
- [hard] REQ-02: Either a fix lands in crates/ such that the cell's regression is credibly removed (bench evidence on at least a pilot-scale ensemble), or the owner explicitly accepts the excursion and amends the epic's REQ-04 disposition; no predeclared value of the frozen procedure moves in either case.
- [hard] REQ-03: The change (if any) leaves the other thirty-three pinned cells' behavior intact under cargo-ci, and the next measured session (session 5) is the arbiter of the pinned set under the standing procedure.
title: Resolve the attributable regression at bit_backend/not_inplace/words=1 before the next measured session
